inferences.text: At 0.62% certified progress in June 2026 and a registered completion of 30 April 2030, almost the whole build is still ahead. A time-based payment plan would run ahead of construction, and the default rules allow the developer to keep up to 25% if a buyer stops paying at this stage.

steps.text: Below 60% completion, a defaulting buyer can lose up to 25% of the price
